summary: Fast Markdown link checker used by the canonical docs lint to validate internal and external links.

commands: if command -v cargo >/dev/null 2>&1; then cargo install lychee; elif command -v brew >/dev/null 2>&1; then brew install lychee; else echo 'Install lychee from https://github.com/lycheeverse/lychee/releases' >&2; exit 1; fi
notes: Prefer a user-managed binary (cargo or Homebrew) so the repository does not own another lockfile or dependency tree.
Verify with `lychee --version` before trusting the docs link verdict.
Update through the same user-tool mechanism that installed lychee; re-run the internal and external link checks after an upgrade.

detect.failure_hint: Install lychee before running the canonical docs lint; do not substitute a Markdown-only checker for link validation.

healthcheck.failure_hint: The lychee binary exists but is not runnable. Reinstall it, then rerun the docs lint.

version_expectation.constraint: Prefer a recent upstream-supported lychee release.

when_missing: The docs link question is unproven without lychee; report the missing binary instead of claiming the Markdown or graph checks cover links.
when_version_mismatch: Treat changed URL parsing or network behavior as a manual review point and rerun the local fixtures before accepting a new version.

host_notes: The repository wrappers own scope and offline/online policy; this manifest only declares the external binary and its lifecycle.
lychee is intentionally not a project dependency: the managed tool is smaller and faster to update than another vendored link checker.
